title: Free Gentle Yoga Tonight at Laredo Public Health — Mats and Equipment Provided
excerpt: Laredo Public Health is offering free gentle yoga classes every Monday in November — including tonight, Monday, Nov. 23, from 5 to 6 p.m. at Laredo Public Healt
content:
Laredo Public Health is offering free gentle yoga classes every Monday in November — including tonight, Monday, Nov. 23, from 5 to 6 p.m. at Laredo Public Health, 2600 Cedar Ave.

The class is led by Tony Flores of Rooted956, who has more than 10 years of experience teaching yoga. It is open to all levels and described as a good fit for after work — a chance to decompress, stretch gently and release stress.

Yoga mats, straps and blocks are provided, and the class is free and open to the public.

For more information, contact Adriana Morales at (956) 552-2876.

Source: Laredo Public Health.
